SILENT LOOP 2
360mm
Significant quiet and exceptional cooling
Silent Loop 2 360mm is the immensely high-performance and whisper-quiet All-in-One water cooling unit for demanding systems with heavily overclocked CPUs.
Damped and adjustable pump with 6-pole motor for very silent and immensely high-performance operationPowerful 3-chamber pump design significantly reduces turbulences and noiseSilent Wings 3 PWM high-speed fans for high performance and whisper-quiet operationCold plate with high density stack of fins for the highest cooling characteristicsARGB LEDs for lots of illumination options and great visual effectsEasy-to-access refill port with coolant bottle included, ensuring a long lifespan3-year manufacturer’s warranty

SUPERIOR PUMP DESIGN
Whisper-quiet operation
A powerful pump with innovative 3-chamber design ensures the very high-performance Silent Loop 2 360mm is whisper-quiet at the same time. The second of its 3 chambers offers enough space for the coolant to spread out and thus reduces turbulences before it leaves the pump unit. In combination with the 6-pole 3-phase motor this results in a smooth and as a consequence silent operation.
WHISPER-QUIET OPERATION
Thanks to effective pump damping
The massive damping of the pump absorbs vibrations and as a consequence minimizes the resonances in the pump housing. This leads to significantly reduced noise and is key to the famously whisper-quiet be quiet! operation.
IMMENSELY HIGH COOLING PERFORMANCE
For low CPU temperatures
Silent Loop 2 360mm as an all-in-one water cooling unit provides enough cooling performance even for demanding applications when the CPU is pushed to its limit. The pump, radiator and fans are all optimized to work in perfect technical symbiosis.
BIG COLDPLATE
For all consumer platforms
Having a high density stack of fins on one side and a nickel coated plate on the other, the cold plate provides maximum cooling performance for the AiO. This makes Silent Loop 2 360mm the perfect water-cooling unit, especially for high-end processors and those with large surfaces. sTRX4 mounting is available separately.
SILENT WINGS 3 FANS
Impressive ratio of performance to noise
The Silent Wings 3 120mm PWM high-speed fan features 7 airflow-optimized fan blades, a 6-pole motor for less vibration and a durable fluid-dynamic bearing. The fan frame is equipped with funnel-shaped air inlets for extremely high air pressure, which makes the fan the perfect choice for radiators.
IMPRESSIVE ILLUMINATION
Lots of options and great visual effects
ARGB LEDs offer multiple colors and modes to individualize the look of the Silent Loop 2 360mm. The illumination can be synced with the ARGB adjustments of the motherboard. You can optionally use the wired ARGB remote controller to switch between modes and colors. The white illumination of be quiet! sign can be turned on and off for an external appearance of any taste.

EASY TO REFILL
Simplified refilling process for a long lifespan
An easy-to-access refill port makes for convenient handling, safe refilling and comfortable maintenance. The coolant bottle included ensures a long lifespan.
"I'm proud about what we achieved with Silent Loop 2. The 6-pole 3 phase motor of the pump in combination with Silent Wings 3 delivers high-end low noise performance. Add additional noise dampening and a 3-chamber design for good fluid dynamics to it and you get a technical marvel.”
Tim Carstensen, R&D Department BU Cooling
